additional_info.implementation_note: SLHS (Saint Luke’s Health System) added to the JCode process effective 1/1/2025; process intended to mirror legacy BJC employees.

billing_and_authorization_rules.office_or_home_setting_for_49_jcodes: Redirect to BJC/SLHS pharmacy benefit; Cigna Medical not billed by BJC Pharmacy; prior auth not needed.
